summary: Isolate non-Git fixtures from ancestor repository discovery

delivery.outcome: Keep governance fixtures and their Python temporary files in this repository cache, with Git discovery bounded so non-Git cases cannot inherit source hub context.
nonGoals: No production allocator behavior or package projection changes
No runtime deployment, releasegrant, tag/Release or adopter effect
No legacy metadata movement or foreign worktree mutation

architecture.decision: The suite owns a non-symlink repository cache and sets TMPDIR plus Git discovery ceiling at that parent. This preserves intentional non-Git bootstrap cases and real nested Git identity. Every native CI invocation now exercises the nested-cache regression.
architecture.rollback: Revert reviewed fixture change through protected publication; keep actual publisher inactive until complete native release checks pass.

validation.evidence: Real non-Git and registered/nested Git cases with repository-owned scratch. Assert the native suite completes without resolving parent hub workstreams.

commands: Independent exact-head protected required CI and Validator
validation.evidence: Complete scoped staged and committed gate; independent App approval and merge. No direct merge or publication authority inferred from local tests.
